verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes joint full-flow UI testing and parallel contract checks.
The client replaces self-guided setup with a live walkthrough and identifies concrete test cases.
The client expands the required testing to specific release paths and services.
The freelancer claims production readiness for live end-to-end mint testing.
The client's actions confirm that testing has moved to live production with real mint attempts.

execution.observed_behavior: Live production testing found that two attempted ETH mints appeared to fail while the site recorded two mints; no-referral allocation could not be confirmed, the dashboard book image was cut off, and book access was unclear.

verdicts.decision_note: The failure is supported, but the original description overstated the uncertain no-referral allocation result.
The freelancer claims the known issues are fixed and requests joint retesting.

execution.observed_behavior: During post-fix testing, the successful-mint popup appeared during USDC approval before a mint completed, and ebook reading became stuck on the cover page after decryption.

verdicts.decision_note: The failure Event should describe only the failed behaviors; the same message separately verifies successful paths.
The client explicitly confirms that the ETH mint path worked correctly.
The client unambiguously accepts the final no-referral test and adds the mobile environment.

execution.observed_behavior: After the mobile no-referral mint, leaderboard totals indicated that a ticket and commission were allocated, although the recipient wallet could not be identified.

verdicts.decision_note: Allocation is supported, but the source does not identify or independently confirm the recipient wallet.
The exchange establishes that the conditional prize-claim path cannot be tested until the 100th sale.

if you have done 3 buys, why is there only one ticket in existence?

On approval for USDC spend (not minting) the 'successful mint' popup appeared, and stated mint number 2 (in this case i used referral code 2), see screenshot with the wallet popup in view.
I cancelled the buy, checked and had no NFT.
Then minted with referral code 3, no approve USDC sign happened, it went straight to mint and worked perfectly, popup appeared. NFT is visible on dashboard.

decrypting the book worked (i had to sign a transaction), but i am stuck on the cover page.

The client confirms that the final mobile no-referral mint completed successfully after restarting the test flow.
